question: A and B can complete a work in 12 days and 20 days, respectively They work together for 4 days. C alone completes the remaining work in 14 days. B and C together can complete the same work in:
solution:
**Given:**

A and B can complete a work in 12 days and 20 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = LCM of the time taken by the workers

**Calculation:**

LCM of 12 and 20 is 60

So, efficiency of A = 60/12 = 5

and b = 60/20 = 3

So, effective efficiency = 5 + 3 = 8

In 4 days they will complete 8 × 4 = 32 units

Remaining = 60 - 32 = 28 units

So, efficiency of C = 28/14 = 2

So, B and C will take = 60/(3 +2) = 12 days
